data.one_liner: An HSV color picker inspired by Chrome devtools and Material Design for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides multiple color picking interfaces including RGB, HSV, Color Wheel, Palette Hue, Saturation, Value, and Swatches. Allows users to select and customize colors via a configurable ColorPicker widget.
use_when: You need a versatile color picker inspired by Chrome devtools in your Flutter app
You want support for RGB, HSV, color wheels, and palettes out of the box
avoid_when: You only need a simple built-in color dialog without custom pickers
strengths: Supports multiple picker types like RGB, HSV, and Color Wheel
Offers customization properties like palette height and orientation

alternatives.name: flutter_colorpicker
alternatives.why_pick_it: A popular alternative package providing a wide variety of color picker widgets and dialogs.

alternatives.name: flex_color_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: A feature-rich color picker for Flutter supporting Material color swatches, custom color customizers, and alpha channel.
